name: Zalando REST API Guidelines Evaluation Rubric
description: Comprehensive style rules based on Zalando RESTful API Guidelines. These guidelines define standards for designing APIs at Zalando and are used by the Zally API linter. Key differentiators include snake_case property naming, cursor-based pagination, and Problem+JSON error handling.

categories.name: General Guidelines
categories.description: API First principle and fundamental requirements

options.label: Fail
criteria: Specification is incomplete or generated from code

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if the API has an OpenAPI specification and follows API First principles. Look for evidence that the spec was created before implementation.

categories.name: Compatibility

options.label: Fail
criteria: Required fields added to existing endpoints

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if the API design avoids breaking changes: no removed fields, no changed field types, no new required fields.

categories.name: JSON Guidelines
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if all JSON property names use snake_case (lowercase with underscores). camelCase is not allowed.

categories.name: Data Formats
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if data types use standard OpenAPI/JSON Schema formats.

categories.name: URL Design
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if collection resource names use plural nouns.

categories.name: HTTP Methods
categories.description: Correct use of GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if HTTP methods are used correctly: GET for reads, POST for creates, PUT for full replacement, PATCH for partial updates.

categories.name: HTTP Status Codes

options.label: Pass
criteria: Problem structure includes type, title, status, detail

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if only standard HTTP status codes are used.

categories.name: Pagination

options.label: Partial
criteria: Both cursor and offset are supported

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if collection endpoints support pagination via cursor/offset and limit parameters.

categories.name: HTTP Headers
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if headers are used appropriately for general context, not operation-specific data.

categories.name: Hypermedia
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if responses include hypermedia links to related resources.

categories.name: Deprecation
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if deprecated elements are marked with deprecated: true.

categories.name: Security
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if OAuth scopes are defined and assigned to operations.

categories.name: Performance
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check if the API design considers performance: pagination, caching, partial responses.
